backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing comment list management with single/bulk comment generation, device tracking, access control integration, and admin functions for creating/managing comment lists.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting five features related to fixing comment list creation button, auto-refreshing dropdowns, button event handlers, performance optimization, and input field clearing.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components, pages, hooks, and configuration for a comment generator application with admin panel and authentication.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS with Tailwind layers defining CSS custom properties for light/dark themes using OKLCH color space for consistent design tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script loading main.tsx for the APP REVIEW application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring React Query, theme provider, and TanStack Router with routes for customer view, upload, live list checker, and admin panel with token gate.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminChatT: Admin UI component for managing chat messages with form inputs for sender/message, send functionality, and a scrollable message history display with timestamps.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminComme: Admin UI component for managing comment lists with functionality to create lists, add comments (bulk or single), delete comments, reset lists, and view bulk comment totals.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminImage: Admin UI component that displays a grid of uploaded rating images with metadata (uploader name, timestamp) and delete functionality.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminLiveL: Admin UI component for managing live list apps and usernames with functionality to create apps, add usernames (bulk or comma-separated), delete apps, and reset username lists.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminSetti: Admin UI component for managing the bulk generator access key with functionality to view current key status (masked), set a new key, and reset the key.
frontend/src/components/AdminTokenGate.t: Authorization guard component that checks admin token validity and displays access denied message or loading state before rendering protected admin content.
frontend/src/components/AnimatedBackdrop: Empty file placeholder for animated backdrop component.
Empty file placeholder for audio player card component.
frontend/src/components/AuthGate.tsx: Empty file placeholder for authentication gate component.
frontend/src/components/EffectBurst.tsx: Empty file placeholder for visual effects burst component.
frontend/src/components/GalleryGrid.tsx: Empty file placeholder for gallery grid component.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Empty file placeholder for login button component.
frontend/src/components/Rotating3DObject: Component rendering a 3D rotating cube with six colored faces using CSS transforms.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Empty file placeholder for site footer component.
frontend/src/components/SiteLayout.tsx: Main layout component with fixed background image, top segmented navigation, outlet for child routes, and footer with Caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/SiteNav.tsx: Empty file placeholder for site navigation component.
frontend/src/components/TeddyMascot.tsx: Empty file placeholder for teddy mascot component.
Sticky top navigation with segmented buttons for Customer View, Upload Section, Live List Checker, and conditionally-rendered Admin Panel based on admin token validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, initializing access control with admin token and invalidating dependent queries on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminComments.ts: Provides React Query hooks for admin comment list management including fetching lists, creating lists, adding/deleting comments, bulk uploads, and resetting lists with query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminToken.ts: Manages admin authentication by checking URL hash and session storage for a hardcoded admin token, providing admin status and access control.
frontend/src/hooks/useBulkGeneratorKey.t: Provides React Query hooks for managing bulk generator API keys including checking key status, setting new keys, and resetting keys.
frontend/src/hooks/useChatMessages.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching all chat messages and adding new chat messages with sender information.
frontend/src/hooks/useCommentGenerator.t: Provides React Query hooks for comment generation including fetching available lists, generating single comments by device ID, and bulk comment generation with access key validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication context and provider for ICP, managing login/logout flow, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useLiveListChecker.ts: Provides React Query hooks for managing live list apps and checking usernames against them, including admin operations like adding/deleting apps and managing usernames.
frontend/src/hooks/useRatingImages.ts: Provides React Query hooks for managing rating images including uploading with uploader name, fetching all images, and deleting images by index.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark themes using OKLCH color space, plus utility classes for pastel backgrounds, cards, buttons, and 3D rotating cube animations.
frontend/src/lib/deviceId.ts: Provides utilities for generating and storing a stable device identifier in localStorage, and tracking which comment lists have been used for single-generation on the current device.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient, InternetIdentityProvider, and renders the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelPage.tsx: Admin panel page with tabbed interface for managing comments, images, chat, live lists, and settings with gradient UI styling.
frontend/src/pages/CustomerViewPage.tsx: Customer-facing page for generating single or bulk comments from selected lists, with device-based single-generation restrictions and admin access code entry.
frontend/src/pages/LiveListCheckerPage.t: Page for checking usernames against selected live list apps, with localStorage persistence for form data and results, and CSV export functionality.
frontend/src/pages/UploadSectionPage.tsx: Page for uploading rating images with uploader name, featuring progress tracking and success feedback using ExternalBlob for file handling.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence and cleanup capabilities.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color system, container settings, border radius variables, and plugins for animations and typography.
project_state.json: Project state for APP REVIEW application tracking 5 fix requests related to non-functional submit buttons, dropdown population, click handlers, and performance optimization. React + TypeScript frontend with Motoko backend for comment list management system.
